sanskrit: tejanāt tyajanaṃ jātaṃ tejanaṃ jāyate śarāt | na yeṣati na śocati yas tvā bibharti tejana ||
english: From the sharpener abandonment is born; from the arrow-shaft abandonment arises. He neither yearns nor grieves, O tejana, who carries you.

sanskrit: parutnam asi tejana parutnaṃ te prabhañjanam | parutno astu sa kāmo yenāmūṃ kāmayāmahe ||
english: You are of ancient standing, O tejana; ancient is your shattering power. Ancient be that desire by which we desire yonder one.

sanskrit: yāvad oṣaḥ śaro astvo janebhyaḥ kṛṇavad bhayam | tāvad oṣas tvaṃ tejana tyajanaṃ bhavatād iha ||
english: As long as a burning arrow, speeding forth, creates fear among people — so long may you, O tejana, be a fiery force of abandonment here.

sanskrit: tyajanaṃ ma āpo dadhan tyajanaṃ maruto dadhan | tyajanaṃ me viśve devās tyajanaṃ pitaro dadhan ||
english: The waters have granted me the power of abandonment; the Maruts have granted me the power of abandonment; all the gods have granted me the power of abandonment; the Fathers have granted me the power of abandonment.

sanskrit: tenāham anyeṣāṃ striyo atyākṣaṃ vidviṣaḥ purā | purā dviṣo atyākṣaṃ purā madhyandinād uta | purā sāyatvād atyākṣaṃ tejane hi mahad balam ||
english: By that power I have surpassed the women of others, the rivals, from before. Before the haters I have surpassed; before midday too; before the evening I have surpassed — for in the tejana there is great power.

sanskrit: asthād dyaur asthāt pṛthivy asthād viśvam idaṃ jagat | asthād avahṛdevāt tiṣṭhāt kāmo ayaṃ tava ||
english: Heaven has stood firm; earth has stood firm; this entire universe has stood firm. Firm stands he from whom love was wrested away — may this desire of yours stand firm.
